title: Existence of the counit-normalized section scalar model
statement: For every morphism a of commutative condensed rings and every scheme T, there exists ScalarSectionData c satisfying ScalarSectionNormalized of [def-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-data]. Its ordinary functor has the actual sectionwise sheafified scalar extension object and map functions, its derived model has a universal cochain counit, and the internal/section comparison satisfies the unit-generator equation and the universal computation square on every cochain complex.
